title: RTWR-1: First Recursive Tri-Tokenization — the Receipt of the First Tri-Write, Tri-Written (Bitcoin OP_RETURN + XRPL AccountSet + Stellar ManageData)
description:
RTWR-1 — the first recursive tri-tokenization on record. The receipt of TWR-1 (the first tri-write: one SHA-256 digest stored on Bitcoin, XRPL, and Stellar under a single joint pre-broadcast commitment) has itself been tri-written on the same three mainnets that made the original historic. The evidence of the capability, carried by the capability itself.

Artifact: TWR1_RECEIPT.md, digest 62a98c6b573578c6ba78cde5c668f0af712690c00be89437f13939c9c82e7f39, prereg frozen pre-broadcast (sha 8b0e811d). Three rails: Bitcoin mainnet OP_RETURN (canonical txid affc072cdb077c6aa8fe8ee0fa404e36504554154de7cd93c7d8b21c0528872b, 700 sats, payload SQDR + 0x01 + digest, hash-only); XRPL AccountSet non-payment storage write (tx 20233970..., ledger 107756266, 10 drops, memo SQDR-XRP-STORE-3); Stellar ManageData SQDR-STORE-2 + memo_hash (network hash 80DAC5C4..., ledger 65021172, 100 stroops). All read-backs byte-exact. Zero identifier-form defects: the ledger-0228 doctrine was applied and verified live (the Bitcoin endpoint returned the canonical txid at broadcast; the Stellar identifier of record is the network hash, not the envelope hash). Total postage: 700 sats + 10 drops + 100 stroops.

Provenance: append-only public ledger (github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen), entries 0224-0228; companion TWR-1 spec DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23465945. MEASURED (scoped): all gates deterministic; no neural-mesh inference in any decision path (program benchmark: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637).

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects. Hash-only on all rails; no client data, no PHI, no credentials (POL-DISC-001).
